description: Small synthetic regression set for Evo's lexical memory retrieval. Expected keys are human-readable fixture identifiers.

memories.content: The local Qwen3.8-27B Q3_K_M baseline runs through llama.cpp with CUDA, approximately 49K context and around 40 tokens per second.
The workstation uses an NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti with 16 GB VRAM, a Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU and about 32 GB system RAM.
For coding tasks inspect repository instructions, define acceptance criteria, make narrow edits, run targeted and full tests, and verify actual command exit codes.
Turn failed attempts, verified outcomes and user corrections into provenance-linked reusable lessons; do not treat model self-reports as verified outcomes.
Persistent memories should retain provenance, confidence, timestamps and supersession history, and be retrievable through lexical or semantic ranking.
Evo should support interchangeable local and optional free or paid cloud model providers without depending on paid cloud access.
The local model scheduler should prioritize foreground interaction and keep the desktop usable while background tasks yield GPU resources.
Published inference optimization claims must be reproduced on the target consumer GPU before being treated as measured local improvements.
